newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sample of work by Nobel literature prize winner.
newsitem.headline: Sample of work by Nobel literature prize winner.

text.p: Following is an example of the work of Polish poet Wislawa Szymborska, the 1996 Nobel Literature Prize winner.
This poem, called "On Death, Without Exaggeration," was taken from the collection "View with a Grain of Sand" (1995) translated by Stanislaw Baranczak and Clare Cavanagh.
This poem is reproduced with permission from the book's publishers, Harcourt Brace & Co in New York.
